text: Integration handoff from O03.1/F02.2: organization_policy supplies the global guard/revision and organization_event supplies atomic local event/receipt plus installation/epoch/hash/certificate slots. Organization changes take the exclusive guard; scientific authorization and leases share it before dataset/credential locks. Curator attribution is not authority after bootstrap. Complete the role/action/provenance matrix, all grant/credential/lifecycle event coverage, current disclosure surfaces and receipt durability semantics. Existing events are LocalOnly; full-state/retry-history scans are an unqualified baseline. O03.2 implements the independent witness. Do not reopen organization catalogs through legacy PostgresRecovery.
